description: Vision benchmark set. Each image is a sealed test: the prompt asks a question with a verifiable answer, and the checks reward the correct answer while penalising hallucination. Images are normalised to max 1280 px on the long side (aspect ratio preserved).

images.title: Counting Polish coins in a grid
images.prompt: Count the exact number of fully visible coins (ones not cut off at the image edges). State the number, describe their arrangement, and say how many partial coins you can see at the edges. Do not guess: only count what is fully visible.
images.expected: 12 fully visible coins in a 3-row x 4-column grid, plus 6 partial coins cut off at the left and right edges (3 on each side).

images.title: Reading a mixed bar chart (July values)
images.prompt: Look at this bar chart titled 'Budget Review: Target Savings Goal vs. Actual Savings'. For the month of July (Jul): what are the values of Actual Savings, Spending, and the Target Savings Goal? What is the difference between the highest and the lowest value in July, and which category has the largest absolute value? State the numbers you read.
images.expected: July: Actual Savings about 900 USD (bar just below 1000), Spending about -3100 USD (bar just below -3000), Target Goal about 1950-2000 USD (orange line just below 2000). Difference between highest (1950-2000) and lowest (-3100) is about 5050. Largest absolute value: Spending (about 3100).

images.title: The impossible Penrose triangle
images.prompt: Is this object physically constructible in 3D space? Answer yes or no first, then describe in detail where the geometry or perspective breaks. If it is an illusion, name it and explain why it works.
images.expected: No - it is not physically constructible. It is the Penrose triangle (tribar), an impossible object. Each bar looks locally like a normal square-section beam, but the three corners connect in a way that cannot exist: the beams appear to recede and advance at the same time, so the far/near joins are contradictory.

images.title: Handwritten medical prescription (OCR)
images.prompt: Transcribe the handwritten prescription on this paper as accurately as you can. List every medication with its dosage and frequency. If a word or digit is unreadable, write [unclear] instead of guessing.
images.expected: Header: TO WHOM IT MAY CONCERN; ICMR guideline; contacts of COVID positive cases; HOME ISOLATION; social distancing, hand hygiene, wearing mask. Prescription: TAB HYDROXYCHLOROQUINE 400 mg once a week; TAB VITAMIN C 1 gram once a day; TAB ZINC 50 mg once a day; in case of fever: TAB CROCIN / CALPOL 650 mg SOS; in case of throat pain and cough: TAB CETIRIZINE 10 mg once a day; SYRUP ALEX 2/3 teaspoon 3 times a day.

images.title: Object detection: two dogs in a living room
images.prompt: How many dogs are in this image? For each dog, describe its type or breed, its colours, and where it is located in the room. Also name the room type and two prominent pieces of furniture.
images.expected: Two dogs. A black-and-tan German Shepherd standing near the centre beside the glass coffee table. A small brown-and-white dog (dachshund/beagle type) lying on the patterned rug in the foreground. Living room with a white TV cabinet/media unit, a brick fireplace, a grey sofa with red cushions, and a patterned armchair.

images.title: Dense scene: Indian market street
images.prompt: Describe this scene in detail. Roughly how many people do you see? What kinds of shops and goods are shown? Read any signs you can make out. Mention at least two specific objects in the foreground.
images.expected: A busy Indian street market. Many people (well over 10, including a man in an orange shirt at a food cart and an older man in the right foreground). Hanging LED light strings, flower garlands (marigold), sacks of snacks, stacked water-bottle crates, steel pots. Shop signs including 'Goldmedal', 'Electric', 'Prag', 'Arihant'. A car at the left edge.

images.title: Dense objects: city intersection traffic
images.prompt: Describe this traffic scene. List the vehicle types you can see and give an approximate count for each type. Are there pedestrians, traffic lights or signs? Which side of the road are the vehicles driving on?
images.expected: A dense urban intersection. A large white-and-green city bus in the left foreground, many cars (white, black, silver, taxi-coloured) - well over 10 vehicles. Pedestrians crossing and walking near the junction. Traffic lights, street signs and mid-rise buildings. Traffic keeps to the right (China-style scene).

images.title: UI screenshot: Confluence page (OCR + layout)
images.prompt: What application is shown in this screenshot? What is the page title? List the main content sections and the links visible in the right-hand sidebar. Also name the logged-in user shown in the left sidebar.
images.expected: Confluence (Atlassian). Page title: 'Empowering Teams Through Effective Communication and Core Values'. Main sections: Purpose, Vision, Values. Right sidebar links: Events, Documentation Style Guide, Questions; also Purpose, Vision, Values, Be Good, From the Heart, Aim for the Best, Fun With Focus, Be Real, Our Story, Major Efforts, Swag Store (IN PROGRESS), Other Projects, Financial Health, Other Fun Facts. Logged-in user: Maggie. Company: Good Software.
